exchanges: ugh my back
Oh no, that doesn't sound good.
doctor finally said its sciatica, which explains the shooting pain down my leg
At least you know what's going on now, I hope treatment helps.
i have to do stretches every morning now
Hopefully they start making a difference soon.
my brother sent pics of his son Lowen learning to crawl, so cute
That's such a sweet milestone.
he goes backwards mostly lol
Backwards still counts as progress.
work was slow, nothing much happens at the hatchery this time of year
A slow day can be a nice break sometimes.
jun brought his accordion to the break room and played polkas for everyone
That sounds like a surprisingly fun break.
some of us loved it, some wanted to leave
That's a pretty fair split for a polka concert.
the minivan is making a clunking noise again
That's worth getting checked before it gets worse.
honestly my Sienna has been nothing but trouble since i bought it used
Used cars can be such a gamble.
cass wants to meet at Bramble tomorrow, its her favourite cafe, they do these massive scones
Massive scones sound like a strong reason to go.
ill go if my back lets me
Hopefully it cooperates.
my brother-in-law just told us they named the baby Marisol
That's a beautiful name, congratulations to them.
so now both sides of the family have new babies
That's a lot of baby cuddles in your future.
my phone is a Nokia from forever ago and people laugh at it
If it works, it works.
it lasts all week on a charge though
That's honestly better than most new phones.
mom's sister Clementine is coming for dinner sunday
That should be a nice family dinner.
she always brings weird casseroles
Weird casseroles can be part of the charm.
i was telling Ignatius about it, hes been my best friend since we were kids
Old friends are the best people to share family stories with.
he thinks the casseroles are a power move
He might be onto something.
still love living in Bellhaven though, the street is so quiet
A quiet street is worth a lot.
ok back is a bit better tonight
Glad to hear it's easing up.
cass says shes been watching Bluey with her niece and is now weirdly invested
It's known for pulling grown-ups in too.
i might have to try it
Could be a fun, easy watch.
